notes: No NHRA rows exist for the F-100 (nhra file empty); EPA file empty (pre-1984). Sources per engine-year: Ford factory brochure for that year (oldcarbrochures.org scans, OCR'd and page images read), Hagerty Valuation Tools per-year F-100 engine list, BlueOvalTech year history page (enthusiast reference site, not a forum), and the Wikipedia F-Series generation article (counted once). Hagerty's pre-1961 and 1970s hp figures are often not factory ratings; factory brochure hp used where readable. 1972+ ratings are SAE net and vary by GVW/emissions; spreads in notes. 1958 has no factory brochure online. 460 V-8 in the F-100 only for 1974. F-100 4x4: 1959-1976; F-100 2WD-only 1977-1983.
